opennyai_summary.final__facts:
02. In the present case, the petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Madhuban P.S.
Case No. 218 of 2021 registered for the alleged offences under Section 406, 420, 504, 506, 120B, 34,
467, 468 & 471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 of the Bihar Protection of Interest of Depositors Act, 2002.
03. As per prosecution case, the informant and other ladies were induced in forming groups of twenty by co-accused Nirbhay Kumar Yadav and other co-accused persons and the ladies numbering twenty paid Rs. 22,500/- each
Further, allegation is that the co-accused Nirbhay Kumar Yadav in conspiracy with other persons of different finance companies took loan in the names of the informant and other lady members and thus, received Rs. 4 crore as loan amount.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
The petitioner has no concern with the Mother Teressa Future Foundation Trust and from the F.I.R., it is clear that the said trust is being run by the co-accused Nirbhay Kumar Yadav.
The petitioner is neither partner nor agent nor employee or associate of the co-accused.
His name has come during investigation of confession of coaccused Nirbhay Kumar Yadav but the said statement is without legal sanctity.
opennyai_summary.final__issue:
06. Having regard to the facts and circumstances and submission made on behalf of the parties and considering the vague nature of accusation and further possibility of false accusation, let the petitioner above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the court concerned within a period of eight weeks from today, be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Court of learned C.J.M., Motihari in connection with Madhuban P.S. Case No. 218 of 2021, subject to the condition laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and other following conditions:
(i) One of the bailors will be a Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51061 of 2024(8)
dt.10-01-2025 close relative of the petitioner.
(ii) The petitioner will remain present on each and every date fixed by the court below, if so required by the learned trial court.
(Arun Kumar Jha, J) anuradha/-
